title: Support inbox
idea: Support inbox: Assigned conversations retain customer context and pending response
audience: People who need to support within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: There is no permissioned shared inbox
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic conversation layout through its support priority and explicit commitment contract: Draft sent delivered and resolved stay distinct
navigation: Support inbox keeps the current support context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Assigned conversations retain customer context and pending response
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to support; teams manage messages with ownership
composition.priority: Draft sent delivered and resolved stay distinct

imagery.role: Support the actual support context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Preserve conversation identity when pane becomes route
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the support inbox structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no support content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Draft sent delivered and resolved stay distinct
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized support content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Draft sent delivered and resolved stay distinct
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active support context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
